search_record: Wikimedia Commons Category:Macintosh Performa: 28 files and 2 subcategories listed; file pages inspected for 630CD, 5200, 5260, 580CD and 6200.

Wikimedia Commons Category:PowerBook: 6 subcategories (68k, Duo, G3, G4, G5, PowerPC) and 1 file (a 2009 museum exhibition photo). The PowerBook subcategories were not browsed file by file. The Performa route gave a clear, identifiable 1994–1995 candidate first.
The Commons API search returned HTTP 429 (rate limit), so individual file pages were read instead of running scripted API queries.
Apple Support technical-specification pages were used as the primary source for release dates.

candidates.creator: Akbkuku (filed under Photographs by Shelby Jueden)
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 as recorded on Commons; upstream says only 'Creative Commons Attribution'
candidates.photo_date: unknown (EXIF 2002 impossible for a D5300; between 2013-10-17 and 2023-07-04)
candidates.strengths: Clean studio shot; model badge legible; matching rear model label photo; 16:9-friendly aspect; high resolution.
candidates.limitations: License version and photographer identity not independently verified. Surface dirt and scuffs on the case. A 1994 model rather than one introduced in 1995.

candidates.creator: Remko van Dokkum
candidates.license: CC BY 2.0, FlickreviewR passed 2018-01-21; Flickr page (read 2026-09-15) also shows CC BY 2.0
candidates.strengths: Best-verified license; a model introduced in 1995.
candidates.limitations: Nokia N95 phone photo from a marketplace listing ('Te koop - For sale'); owner-applied Apple logo sticker, so not stock appearance; lower resolution. The Commons original download returned HTTP 429 repeatedly, so the image was judged from the file page description, not viewed at full size.

candidates.limitations: Low resolution (808 px tall) for a 1080p frame; license at source unconfirmed; download returned HTTP 429.
